tenderSchedule.title: KSDARKK202627
tenderSchedule.description: To Outsource the service of an Agency to provide various man power support to Strengthening of Integrated Call Center project proposed under PM-RKVY Scheme

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Commissionerate of Agriculture, Sheshadfri Road, Bengaluru-01

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Organizational Structure and experience in the field, and also clearly showing the complete mailing address of its head office and branch office in the state of Karnataka, and official e-mail, telephone number.

The Bidder shall necessarily be a legally valid entity either in the form of a private limited companies or Firms or LLP or Partnership Firm or Proprietorship Firms A proof for supporting the legal validity of the Bidder shall be submitted. The company should have been in business for five years at the time of bidding.
Registered Office in Karnataka is Mandatory
The bidder should be GST Registered.
The bidder should be registered with the Provident Fund and ESI organizations.
The bidder should be registered with the Income Tax Department
The bidder must have income tax returns filed

The bidder s average annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year should be at least Rs. 2.00 Crore Rupees Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
A. The bids without Earnest Money shall be summarily rejected. B EMD & Performance security should be in favor of the Beneficiary, wherever it is applicable.

A.Bidder should have minimum experience for services with a minimum value of Rs. 2.00 Crore each year for two or more Government departments OR PSU during the last three years only. A.Also, the bidder should have provided manpower in numbers of not less than 80% of the manpower mentioned in the document in a given year to two or more Government departments/PSUs within the State of Karnataka during the last three years only.

Bidder/Supplier/ Organization/ Proprietor/ Any of the Director(s) shall not be banned or suspended, or black listed by any Government / Public Sector Undertaking / Corporate organization, or convicted in any Court of Law across India, or declared Bankrupt or insolvent. A self-declaration certificate must be uploaded in the Karnataka Public Procurement portal under the Bidders' Official Letter Head.
The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, nor should it be bankrupt. Bidder to upload the undertaking to this effect with the bid.
license as required under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970, and Karnataka Rules, 1974, and Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961
Separate letter in the company letterhead to be uploaded
